metadata.title: Delight Sample — Cursor Primitives in Action

slides.headline: Cursor turns brand rules into branded decks in minutes

content.subtitle: Skills, rules, and agents — proved by the PowerPoint

notes.opening: This deck shows the workflow in the artifact it produces.

Skills are the buttons people type

slides.headline: Brief to PPTX runs as one agent pipeline

content.caption: Customers type skills; agents do the multi-step work

notes.opening: The workflow is a chain of explicit, inspectable steps.
points: The export is the proof artifact
notes.transition: Three primitives make that pipeline usable by people.

slides.headline: Three primitives stay visible in every leave-behind

bullets.text: Rules load brand without anyone typing @ or /
bullets.detail: Palette and voice stay present by default

bullets.text: Skills appear under / as the human-facing workflow
Agents orchestrate outline, slides, visuals, and review
bullets.detail: The pipeline delegates each step to a specialist

content.takeaway: People invoke a simple workflow while the system carries the complexity

notes.opening: The workflow stays understandable because each primitive has a clear job.
notes.transition: That distinction is why this is more than another app.

content.quote: This is not a new IT app. Marriott already uses Cursor — this turns organic usage into a repeatable builder workflow.

notes.opening: This is the practical interpretation of the numbers and pipeline.
points: The builder workflow makes it repeatable
The artifact gives leadership something concrete
